counts.hotels: number — total GDI hotels in catalog

hotelRow.hotelName: string — report hotel name when available
hotelRow.available: boolean — customer-ready GDI report data exists

reportStatus.derivation: from available + ready/watch counts + reason (no second state model)

pdfStatus.note: Client may overlay GENERATING / FAILED during in-flight generate

hotelRow.lastGeneratedAt: ISO string|null — from PDF store meta.generatedAt
hotelRow.gdiShareAvailable: boolean — existing GDI share exists (no URL in catalog)
hotelRow.adpShareAvailable: boolean — existing ADP share exists (no URL in catalog)

actions.externalClientLinks: GET /api/admin/ai-demand/hotels/:hotelId/external-client-links (on Open/Copy only; createIfMissing not used by default)
actions.archive: sessionStorage dealality_report_archive_focus → tab report-archive filtered hotelId + reportType=GDI
